newsitem.title: INDIA: Calcutta prices end lower, most bourses closed.
newsitem.headline: Calcutta prices end lower, most bourses closed.

text.p: Calcutta shares closed lower on Thursday on low volumes and lack of any interest with other regional bourses closed, brokers said.
They said that Bombay and New Delhi exchanges closed for a Hindu festival and only the Bombay-based National Stock Exchange (NSE) open, few traders were willing to trade.

"Few traders who were active today were mostly into arbitrage business. Calcutta traders were seen selling on NSE and NSE traders were selling at the Calcutta Stock Exchange (CSE) today," said Aprajit Sharma of brokers Jet Age Securities.
"Most prices were range-bound in the absence of any direction from foreign funds. Prices moved in the narrowest range at times, just 40 paise (cents) up or down," Sharma added.
